0b643dcd44: Reference: caring for an acoustic guitar and changing strings
114a95b2a0: Fretboard: clean it when changing strings, and oil rosewood and ebony fretboards once or twice a year. Body: wipe off sweat after playing, keep it out of sun, heat and damp, and hold humidity around 45–55%.
a951f759da: Strings: change them when they sound dull or show rust; phosphor bronze is warm and durable, 80/20 bronze bright, coated strings last longer.
ff2349c8f9: Changing strings: one string at a time, fix the ball end with the bridge pin, leave two or three frets' length to wind round the peg, wind in one direction, then tune, gently stretch the string and tune again.
